summary.text: Ellen Rockmore is a Democratic member of the New Hampshire House of Representatives from Grafton 12 who has held the seat since December 4, 2024 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
According to Ballotpedia, she earned degrees from Yale College and New York University and worked as a professor.
